tools.name: explain_formula
tools.description: Explains an Excel or Google Sheets formula in plain English and returns the equivalent in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL and pandas, with common pitfalls. Use when the user has a specific formula they do not understand or want to move to another tool.

tools.name: search_formula_library
tools.description: Searches 60 hand-checked worked examples of common spreadsheet tasks (lookups, SUMIFS, dates, text cleanup, arrays) and returns the formula with Excel, Google Sheets, SQL and pandas versions, pitfalls and a link. Use for 'how do I ...' spreadsheet questions.
